title: Same sign
prompt: Return true if a and b are both zero-or-positive, or both negative. Otherwise return false.
signature: func solve(a: int, b: int) -> bool:
starter:
func solve(a: int, b: int) -> bool:
	return false
hint: Combine `and` and `or`, using parentheses to group: `(a >= 0 and b >= 0) or (a < 0 and b < 0)`.
solution:
func solve(a: int, b: int) -> bool:
	return (a >= 0 and b >= 0) or (a < 0 and b < 0)
